skills.description: This skill should be used when a user needs to record accounting vouchers for Kingdee Jingdouyun (金蝶精斗云), turning local source documents (invoice exports, bank statements, payroll) into an importable Excel voucher file and running pre-closing validation. Trigger scenarios: "帮我把这几个月的单据做成精斗云凭证", "金蝶记账/出凭证", "生成可导入金蝶的凭证并审核", "结账前帮我检查凭证对不对". Important boundary: Jingdouyun is a web SaaS with no open API, the AI produces the file while the user performs the import, profit-carry-forward, closing and tax-filing clicks in the browser.
